label: Bible Study
prompt: It was meet that we should make _____, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
verse: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
note: The father's answer to the resentful older brother — the prodigal's party was a must.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' _____, and brought you unto myself.
verse: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
note: At Sinai God sums up the whole Exodus in one picture: I carried you on eagles' wings and brought you to myself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there arose a great _____ of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
verse: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
note: A great storm of wind, a boat filling with water — and Jesus asleep in the back on a pillow.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The _____ is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.
verse: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.
note: Eli's daughter-in-law named her newborn Ichabod on the day the ark was captured — the glory had gone.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a _____ before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verse: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
note: Ezekiel the watchman learns the stakes: if he fails to warn the backslider, God will require that blood at his hand.
